name: DM02b: Known Diabetes Mellitus cases
description:
Number of clients active on ART who are documented as known Diabetes Mellitus cases during the reporting quarter.
The patient must have a known-diabetic status during the reporting quarter. Known statuses include controlled, uncontrolled, on treatment, and not on treatment. Patients newly diagnosed during the same quarter are excluded so that DM02a and DM02b remain mutually exclusive.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND a.diabetes_mellitus_status IN (
      'Known Diabetic and not controlled on lifestyle modification',
      'Known Diabetic and not controlled on medication and lifestyle modification',
      'Known Diabetic but not on Treatment',
      'Known Diabetic and controlled on medication and lifestyle modification',
      'Known Diabetic and controlled on lifestyle modification'
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card n
      WHERE n.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND n.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
        AND n.diabetes_mellitus_status IN (
            'Newly Diagnosed and on lifestyle modification',
            'Newly Diagnosed and on lifestyle modification and Medication'
        )
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND (
            x.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR x.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
